narrative.headline: Search products, manage your cart, and retrieve purchases using your own signed-in session.
narrative.value_prop: Read products and past purchases through direct HTTP. Cart changes target explicit items and return a verified resulting cart.
narrative.auth_narrative: Sign in to homedepot.com in Safari, then run homedepot-pp-cli auth import. For Chrome, run homedepot-pp-cli auth login --chrome. Session cookies preserve domain, path and expiry in a private 0600 local file at ~/.local/share/homedepot-pp-cli/cookies.json, or the directory selected by --home. An absolute HOMEDEPOT_COOKIE_FILE selects another private file. Imports verify a protected request before replacing the stored session. Run homedepot-pp-cli auth status --verify for a live check; auth logout removes the stored session. No developer API key is needed.
